meta.name: debugging
meta.description: MUST USE for any real runtime debugging across ANY language or binary — crashes, silent failures, wrong responses, stuck processes, memory leaks, async misbehavior, unexplained timing, reverse engineering. Runs a hypothesis-driven loop: form ≥3 hypotheses, investigate in parallel, after 2 failed rounds spawn Oracles from orthogonal angles, confirm root cause, lock with a failing test, fix minimally, QA by actually USING the system, scrub artifacts. The actual HOW lives in `references/` — READ THEM. Triggers: 'debug this', 'why is X not working', 'hanging', 'attach a debugger', 'reverse engineer', 'pwndbg', 'gdb', 'lldb', 'node inspect', 'pdb', 'dlv', 'delve', 'rust-gdb', 'set a breakpoint', 'context window exploded', 'why is the response empty', 'why is this happening', 'trace this bug', 'reproduce and fix', 'silent failure', 'HTTP 200 but empty', 'why did it stop', 'inspect the binary', 'playwright', 'flaky test', 'fails intermittently', 'passes in isolation', 'only fails in CI'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 定位并修复各类运行时故障，从崩溃到内存泄漏
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果 你常遭遇崩溃、泄漏或莫名失败却难以定位根因。
copy.tagline_en: Diagnose and fix any runtime failure, from crashes to memory leaks.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often face crashes, leaks, or unexplained failures and can't find the root cause.

howto.what: 调试时以实际运行为准,不凭读码猜测;先写调试日志,提至少三个假设并行查证;两轮失败后换角度生成多个独立验证;确认根因后用失败测试锁定,最小修复,并真实运行验证,最后清理全部临时文件。
howto.when: 当用户要求调试任何语言/二进制的真实运行问题(崩溃、卡死、内存泄漏等),或说出“debug this”“attach a debugger”等触发词,或要求逆向分析时触发。

say.text: 为什么我的 Node 服务有时会卡住?
say.note: 会先读取 Node 调试参考,再并行排查卡住原因。

say.text: 用 lldb 附加到这个进程,看看它停在哪。
say.note: 会先读原生二进制调试参考,然后用 pwndbg 附加。

say.text: 这个测试只在 CI 上失败,本地通过,为什么?
say.note: 会读取间歇性故障排查指南,优先缩小范围。

howto.what_en: Claude debugs from runtime state, journals artifacts, forms ≥3 hypotheses, investigates in parallel, spawns Oracles after 2 failures, confirms root cause, locks with a failing test, fixes minimally, verifies by using the system, cleans up.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to debug runtime issues (crashes, hangs, memory leaks, etc.), or says trigger phrases like 'debug this' or 'attach a debugger', or asks for reverse engineering.

say_en.text: Why does my Node service sometimes hang?
say_en.note: It reads the Node reference and investigates in parallel.

say_en.text: Attach with lldb to this process and show where it stops.
say_en.note: Reads the native-binary reference first, then uses pwndbg.

say_en.text: This test only fails in CI, not locally. Why?
say_en.note: It uses the flaky-test triage guide to narrow it down.
